Lemon Ginger Water
By: Julia
Published: Wednesday, January 4, 2017 - 1:55pm

Ingredients




1l (1 quart) Water (filtered or bottled)
30-40g (1-1.4oz) Ginger Root
1 Lemon (Medium-Large)

Preparation

1 Wash, peel and slice ginger. Throw it in a jug filled with water and place in the fridge overnight. 2 The following morning, pour into a glass and heat up until lukewarm. Squeeze in a wedge of a lemon and drink before your breakfast. 3 Drink throughout the day cold (or lukewarm if preferred). Always squeeze lemon in right before drinking to get the most health benefits out of it. 4 The post Body Cleansing Lemon Ginger Water appeared first on HappyFoods Tube.

About
